basis.governing_question: Should Quinta Azul enter the Spanish retail market and, if so, how?

phases.name: Research
phases.objective_one_line: Assess the Spanish grocery retail market, its competitors and whether Quinta Azul has what it takes to win there.

gate.label: Go/no-go on design
gate.decision: Is the research evidence strong enough to design a Spanish entry, or stop here?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Compare Spanish entry options and build the business case and roadmap behind the go or no-go decision on Spain.

gate.label: Final decision
gate.decision: Approve the go or no-go on Spain and, if go, the entry plan?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not stated; 8-12 weeks is an estimate for one market and two decision-makers, so confirm it before quoting.
The Design weeks assume a go on Spain; a no-go at the Research gate would end the engagement after Research.
